collection.title: Rover 200 Coupe 1992 to 1996 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Rover 200 Coupe 1992 to 1996 model which requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
